title: Costs: what the client actually pays
objectives: State the cost structure of MF, PMS and AIF, with caps.
Say which document carries the full AIF fee structure.
body_md:
MF: one expense ratio, capped by SEBI and already reflected in the NAV. Direct plans have no distributor commission. PMS: fixed fee and/or profit share, plus brokerage, custody and GST. Operating expenses (excluding brokerage) are capped at 0.5% a year. AIF: management fee plus carried interest (a share of profits above a hurdle), plus fund expenses. Read the Private Placement Memorandum (PPM) for the full structure.

> **Investor takeaway:** Compare costs, lock-in and tax side by side before choosing PMS or AIF over a mutual fund.
